integrity: Proof is self-contained and exact; independent external validation has not been performed. The 27 exact tests do not replace the infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: Complex coefficients, finite abelian core quandles, right Peirce spectrum from nonzero idempotents only. title: The fourth-torsion threshold for Peirce spectra of finite abelian core quandles
